name: truing_orchestrator
description: Orchestrator (SPEC §5.1, §7): the state machine, outer cycle loop and inner per-spoke apply loop, operator-wait states, abort handling, current-state snapshot and current-cycle provenance. Framework-free (P3): it sequences the subsystem contracts and holds no measurement logic. Includes the auto-operator test driver that answers waits so the workflow can run with zero hardware (SPEC §14.5).
